'''Val Denn''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the planet [[Tinnel IV/Legends|Tinnel IV]], located in the [[Tinnel system/Legends|Tinnel system]] of the [[Quanta sector/Legends|Quanta sector]].

During the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Tiaan Jerjerrod]] owned a private estate in Val Denn.
